review:
Cash Grotto is an underground treasure game set across 24 separate reels, combining several Wazdan mechanics at once. Hold the Jackpot is triggered by landing 4 Bonus symbols on the highlighted central reels and starts with 3 respins to collect more symbols, with jackpots of up to 1,500x the bet.

Cash Infinity symbols stay on the reels until the bonus and make it more likely to trigger, while Sticky to Infinity locks Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols until the bonus ends. Moving Cash Out travels down a reel, collects the Bonus values on it and can multiply the total by up to 300%. Chance Level offers three bet multipliers that change bonus frequency, not payouts. Wazdan lists a 96.13% RTP and high volatility.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
